description: Locally return a bounded, pinned catalog of listed Morpho Vault V2 deployments plus official direct-discovery guidance. This tool makes no API, RPC, indexer, or other network request. The agent must query Morpho's public GraphQL API and current onchain state directly, then intersect the result with the fixed chain, vault, and asset addresses before preparation.

chain_id.description: Optional exact chain filter for the fixed Morpho Vault V2 catalog

name: get_morpho_vaults
title: List fixed Morpho Vault V2 deployments
